newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan orders hog trading halted for at least three days.
Beijing denies it will hold exercise next month.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Dalai Lama says establishment of Taiwan office expected to be approved.
Seventeen island-wide markets halt hog trading for five days.
LIBERTY TIMES - Hog foot and mouth disease has origin in China.
Dalai Lama says he seeks self-rule, not independence, for Tibet.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to raise basic wage by about three percent this year.
Three banks lower loan interest rates for hog breeders.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong says bank will inject funds into banking system when necessary.
Eight Taiwan firms awarded mobile data licences.
